strategy_description: I want a model that cooperates against all curent bots in the library, and defects with new ones
lean_source:
import PrisonersDilemma.Program
import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.CooperateBot
import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.DefectBot
import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.TitForTatBot
import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.MirrorBot
import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.DBot
import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.OBot
import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.EBot
import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.CupodBot

open PD
namespace PD.Bots

/-- TestBot cooperates against every bot currently in the library
    (identified by structural identity of the opponent's source), and
    defects against any unrecognized ("new") bot. The `.search` budget `k`
    is a parameter, as required. -/
def TestBot (k : Nat) : Prog :=
  .search k (.eq .opp (.bot CooperateBot)) (.const Action.C) <|
  .search k (.eq .opp (.bot DefectBot)) (.const Action.C) <|
  .search k (.eq .opp (.bot TitForTatBot)) (.const Action.C) <|
  .search k (.eq .opp (.bot MirrorBot)) (.const Action.C) <|
  .search k (.eq .opp (.bot DBot)) (.const Action.C) <|
  .search k (.eq .opp (.bot OBot)) (.const Action.C) <|
  .search k (.eq .opp (.bot EBot)) (.const Action.C) <|
  .search k (.eq .opp (.bot (CupodBot k))) (.const Action.C) <|
  (.const Action.D)

end PD.Bots
